Maya (CSM): FYI — SkylarkCorp's onboarding funnel just spiked in drop-off after step 3 (model upload). Renewal in ~38 days. Trial seats mostly idle, DAU down ~42% week-over-week. Need a short rescue play to avoid a downgrade. Thoughts?

Josh (Success Ops): digging into telemetry now — seeing consistent 500s from the upload endpoint for files >120MB between 03:00-09:00 UTC. Filed an infra alert, tagging eng-runtime.

Eli (SE): if upload fails, we should offer an alternate path: provide a hosted template + invite them to upload a sampled model (smaller shard) so they can continue integration. I can prepare a conversion helper.

Tara (Onboarding): I can run a 30-min checkpoint tomorrow PST. Suggest we send a pre-call checklist (logs, sample inputs, expected latency) and share screen to walk model load.

Ben (Renewals): commercial angle: if activation doesn't improve quickly, customer will likely downgrade to lower tier. Recommend we propose a short 30-day extension + 1:1 onboarding + waive setup fee as an incentive to keep them engaged.

Maya (CSM): Good. Proposed "activation sprint" rescue: 3 touchpoints over 14 days, clear success criteria (inference >= 1k tokens/day OR first production inference), and a compact remediation checklist. I'll draft the outreach email.

playbook-bot: created ticket #CS-4621 (temporary rescue) and assigned to Maya. SLA: initial remediation plan due in 72h.

Josh (Success Ops): quick tactical: we can set a feature flag to allow chunked uploads (client-side chunking & server retry). Patch pushed to staging, monitoring enabled. cc @eng-runtime for rollout.

Eli (SE): prepping conversion helper. Dropping the initial snippet here for the team to test:
```bash
python convert_model.py --source large_model.bin --shard-size 64 --output small_shards/
```
Run that on a laptop/VM and upload one shard to the portal to validate the pipeline.

Tara (Onboarding): I'll send calendar invites for 1:1 and share this checklist in the invite: - collect logs + error timestamps - sample input file (<=64MB) - agreed success metric - pointer to conversion helper

Maya (CSM): Assigning actions now: Josh -> infra patch & monitor (24h), Eli -> conversion script + runbook (48h), Tara -> schedule calls + send checklist (48h), Ben -> draft commercial offer phrasing for extension (48h). I'll run daily check-ins in this thread and update #CS-4621. Thanks team :rocket:

Ben (Renewals): I'll draft the offer and drop text here for quick approval.

Maya (CSM): Perfect — let's prioritize runway over features for this customer. If we hit success criteria, we'll convert to a handbook entry for similar onboarding stalls.
